title: 第480章 以权谋私的云公子们二合一第479章 招人恨的妖孽
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世

第480章以权谋私的云公子们（二合一）
“日上三竿我独眠，谁是神仙？我是神仙。”
缓慢的吟哦声响起，伴着云烁孩童嬉闹的笑声。
偷得浮生半日闲的云擎仰望云海翻涌，仙风悠悠，温柔闲适的时光在指尖缓缓流淌，心下暗忖：
待忙完大局，定要好好撸一撸两只毛茸茸。唔，也不知小狗蛇修炼的如何了，盘一盘小蛇冰凉的鳞片，也是不错的消遣嘛。
“唉呀。”动物园里一只小家伙都没有的云大公子，仰天长叹。
游湖之后，云瑶又带几人去了云梦泽几处特色之地。
一处是云梦泽有名的云梦花树。
此树乃是云氏一位先辈栽种的后天灵木，如今堪堪抵达九千九百九十九载芳龄，枝桠舒展如云絮漫卷，层层叠叠的粉白花簇缀满繁枝，万千剔透的云铃垂挂枝梢，随风轻晃便有绵软的云雾散出。
这些云铃以流云精魄淬炼而成，内里自成一方小小音域。万古以来往来此地的云氏族人、交好的诸天大能皆会在此留下印记。
有修士将对道途的祈愿封入铃中，有剑修随手将剑意封入，更有不少性情随性之辈…咳把骂人的话塞进去，专等仇家路过便会咆哮出声，也算是诸天独一份的泄愤趣事。
云烁从二长老牵着的手中挣脱，蹦跳着伸手去拨弄一枚低垂的云铃，结果铃身一颤，吼声骤然炸响：
“狗贼还钱！休要装作视而不见！”
云烁被吓了一跳，猛地缩回手，下意识躲到云擎身侧。
结果云渊听完抚着胡须仰头大笑，说这东西多半是姜守拙年轻时留下的。
云擎和云厉云瑶三个小年轻立时肃然起敬。
万万没想到那般温润老练的一方巨擘，年少时竟还有这般“不拘小节”的行径，还有那被讨债的“狗贼”……
二长老，别以为他们没发现，那铃铛分明就是朝着您去的吧？！
几人相视一笑，云擎颇觉有趣，也抬手取了一枚空白云铃。
他俯身递给小弟云烁，抬眸见云瑶与云厉并无动作的意思，眉梢一挑，随即了然。

“哦~我们小情侣怕是早早就在此处点卯过了。”
云厉耳根一红，牵着云瑶的手紧了一瞬，云瑶也是面泛红霞。云擎所料不错，二人早在定情那日便一同将两枚云铃挂上了枝头。
唯恐大兄再继续打趣，云厉连忙上前又取了枚空白云铃，“恭恭敬敬”地一把塞进了云擎手里。
“哈哈哈。”云擎朗声一笑，放了这小子一马。他转头看向二长老，举着铃铛示意了一下。
二长老云渊摆摆手道：“老夫一把年纪，就不玩你们小孩子家家的东西了。”
“哦~”云擎又拉长语气调侃了一声。
二长老不理。
“好好好，你们年轻时都已玩过，就我没见识。”云擎笑着指尖轻抚铃铛外壁，低头看着云烁。
“烁儿想留些什么在里面？稍后为兄帮你挂上去。”
“咱们兄弟俩玩，不理他们。”云擎眨了眨眼，身后三人各自抬头望天望地。
啊，这花树真大啊。
“愿兄长岁岁平安。”云烁年纪尚浅，心性纯粹烂漫，铃中封入的是孩童最赤诚的念想。
轮到云擎，他重瞳掠过整片云梦泽的云海万里，过往厮杀奔波在心中一闪而过，最终只留下一句淡然悠远的心音：
“愿守族中亲友无虞，踏遍道途，行止无愧本心。”
铃音宽阔平和，裹挟着仙君境浑厚的道韵，令周遭花枝都缓缓舒展。
“大哥，我的要挂在最上面！”云烁举着铃铛，一双小狗眼亮晶晶的。
云擎看得心下一软，飞身而上，将他和自己的铃铛一同挂的高高的。
临走时，云擎又将一枚云铃收入袖中，打算之后带回天外天给云煌。
“煌弟的话，会说什么呢？”他开始回忆云煌那些狂傲霸气的仙帝语录。
往后百千年岁月流转，云梦花树承载了二位仙帝的大道回音，以致诸天无数修士慕名专程到访花树之下，将此地视作祈福悟道的一处灵地。

待到岁月再翻过许多年光阴，这株扎根云梦泽的后天灵木一朝化形，通晓万古此间所有铃音旧事，守在云梦泽长伴云海，成了云氏主城独一无二的花灵守护……这些绵长的因果羁绊，皆是彼时一行人闲游花树时，不曾预料到的遥远后话了。
此时此刻，游完此处，一行人便又去了浮云书楼。
楼中收着云梦泽各支脉族史、游记、地志，还有许多旧日大能随手写下的杂谈。

Chapter 480 Mr. Yun who uses power for personal gain (two in one)
"I sleep alone at three o'clock in the morning. Who is the god? I am the god."
A slow groan sounded, accompanied by the playful laughter of Yun Shuo's child.
Yun Qing, who had stolen half a day's leisure, looked up at the sea of clouds, the fairy wind, the gentle and leisurely time slowly flowing through his fingertips, and thought to himself:
After finishing the big picture, I must take care of my two furries. Well, I don’t know how the little snake’s cultivation is going. It’s a good pastime to coil the cold scales of the little snake.
"Oh." Mr. Yun, who didn't even have a baby in the zoo, looked up to the sky and sighed.
After visiting the lake, Yunyao took several people to several unique places in Yunmengze.
One is the famous Yunmeng Flower Tree in Yunmengze.
This tree is an acquired spiritual tree planted by an ancestor of the Yun family. It is now nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine years old. Its branches stretch like clouds, with layers of pink and white flower clusters dotted all over the branches. Thousands of clear cloud bells hang from the branches, and soft clouds are scattered in the gentle breeze.
These cloud bells are tempered with the essence of flowing clouds, and have a small sound field of their own. The people of the Yun clan who have traveled here throughout the ages and the great powers who have made friends with them will all leave their mark here.
There are monks who seal their prayers for the path into bells, there are sword cultivators who seal their sword intentions casually, and there are also many people with casual temperaments... who stuff curse words into them, waiting for their enemies to pass by and then roar out, which is the only fun thing in the world to vent their anger.
Yun Shuo broke away from the hands held by the second elder, jumped up and reached out to fiddle with a low-hanging Yun Bell. As a result, the bell trembled, and the roar suddenly exploded:
"The thief pays you back! Don't pretend to turn a blind eye!"
Yun Shuo was startled, she retracted her hand suddenly and subconsciously hid beside Yun Qing.
After hearing this, Yun Yuan raised his head and laughed while stroking his beard, saying that this thing was probably left behind by Jiang Shouzhuo when he was young.
The three young men, Yun Qing and Yun Li Yunyao, were immediately in awe.
I never expected that such a gentle and experienced giant would behave in such a "non-trivial" manner when he was young, as well as the "dog thief" who was being collected for debt...
Second Elder, don’t think they haven’t noticed, that bell is clearly heading towards you, right? !
Several people looked at each other and smiled. Yun Qing found it interesting and raised his hand to take out a blank Yun Bell.
He leaned over and handed it to his younger brother Yun Shuo. He raised his eyebrows and saw that Yun Yao and Yun Li had no intention of moving.
"Oh~ I'm afraid we, the young couple, have already clicked here."
Yun Li's ears turned red and he held Yun Yao's hand tightly for a moment. Yun Yao's face also turned red. Yun Qing's expectation was good. The two of them had hung two cloud bells on the branches together as early as the day they fell in love.
Fearing that his elder brother would continue to joke, Yun Li quickly stepped forward and took out another blank Yun Bell, and "respectfully" stuffed it into Yun Qing's hand.
"Hahaha." Yun Qing laughed loudly and let the boy go. He turned to look at the second elder and raised the bell to signal.
The second elder, Yunyuan, waved his hand and said, "When I get older, I won't play with your children's things anymore."
"Oh~" Yun Qing teased again in a longer tone.
The second elder ignored him.
"Okay, okay, you have all played it when you were young, but I have never seen it." Yun Qing smiled and touched the outer wall of the bell with his fingertips, looking down at Yun Shuo.
"What do you want to keep in there, Shuo'er? Brother, I will help you hang it up later."
"Let's play as brothers and ignore them." Yun Qing blinked, and the three people behind him each looked up at the sky and the ground.
Ah, this flower tree is so big.
"May my brother be safe all year round." Yun Shuo is still young and has a pure and innocent heart. What is sealed in the bell is the most sincere thoughts of a child.
It was Yun Qing's turn. His eyes swept across the vast sea of clouds in Yunmengze. The battles and battles in the past flashed through his mind. In the end, only a calm and distant voice remained:
"I hope that my relatives and friends in the clan will be safe, and that I will walk on the road and conduct myself with integrity."
The sound of the bell is broad and peaceful, carrying the rich Taoist rhyme of the Immortal Lord Realm, making ZhouAll the flowers and branches slowly spread out.
"Brother, I want to hang mine at the top!" Yun Shuo held up the bell, her puppy eyes shining brightly.
Yun Qing's heart softened when he saw it, and he flew up and hung him and his bell high together.
Before leaving, Yun Qing put another Yun Bell in his sleeve, planning to bring it back to Tianwaitian to Yun Huang.
"What would Brother Huang say?" He began to recall Yunhuang's arrogant and domineering Immortal Emperor's quotes.
As hundreds of thousands of years passed, the Yunmeng Flower Tree carried the echoes of the two Immortal Emperors' great ways, so that countless monks from all over the world made a special trip to visit under the flower tree, treating this place as a spiritual place to pray for blessings and enlightenment.
After many more years passed, this acquired spiritual tree that took root in Yunmengze transformed into one, and knew all the past events of the past eternity. It stayed in Yunmengze and accompanied the sea of ​​clouds forever, becoming the unique flower spirit guardian of Yun's main city... These long causal bonds were all distant events that the group had not expected when they were wandering around the flowers and trees.
At this moment, after visiting here, the group went to Fuyun Library again.
The building contains the histories of Yunmengze's various clans, travel notes, topography, and many miscellaneous remarks written by the great masters of the past.
